_comment: The household economy: families earn wages, pay income tax, and buy what they use. Coin per day.

governments.name: Free Traders
governments.description: Low taxes and pay by skill: craftsmen and masters prosper, labourers get by, and only bread is given to those who can't pay.

governments.name: Common Weal
governments.description: Higher taxes pay for the poor: food, warmth, faith and the market are free to those who can't afford them. Pay is evened out somewhat.

governments.name: Commune
governments.description: Everyone is paid the same and the common stores sell cheaply, but most of the pay goes back to the commune.

governments.name: Iron Rule
governments.description: The army comes first: soldiers are paid half as much again, and taxes are high to pay them. Only bread for the poor.
